summary: Implemented rich.progress open and wrap_file (module-level and Progress methods) with private _ProgressReader and _ProgressContext helpers in rich/progress.py, plus 17 new tests in tests/test_progress.py, a "Reading from a file" / "Reading from a file-like object" docs section in docs/source/progress.rst, and a CHANGELOG bullet under Unreleased/Added linking PR 1759. Nothing was committed. Tests, mypy, and black were not run per instructions, so verification was by reading only. Deviations to review: added read-only name and mode properties on the reader (typing.IO declares them abstract, which blocks instantiation on Python 3.6); the context wrapper is generic, so I did not add the return-value/type-variable ignore the spec mentions for module-level open, and strict mypy may flag this either way; module-level open uses a cast on mode to satisfy the overloads; readinto returns the byte count.
